dedupe_keys.name: servicio mapa tematico de instalaciones de servicios de temporada y concesiones en el dominio publico maritimo terrestre de las islas baleares

description: Servicio mapa temático de instalaciones de servicios de temporada y concesiones en el dominio público marítimo-terrestre de las Islas Baleares is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ideib.caib.es. Distribution of seasonal service facilities in the maritime-terrestrial public domain of the Balearic Islands, which are published in this CDE for information purposes, corresponding to Royal Decree 994/2022, of November 29, on the transfer of functions and services from the State Administration to the Autonomous Community of the Balearic Islands in matters of coastal planning ... Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Thematic map service of seasonal service facilities and concessions in the maritime-terrestrial public domain of Baleari" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include season, instalaciones, beach, platja, Govern de les Illes Balears, playa. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
